execution_requirements: Use Bazelisk and the repository tools/bazel wrapper; verify selected executable hash before measurement.
Preserve repository .bazelrc; inspect and record any user.bazelrc import. Ignore system/home rc files for the controlled run.
Set DD_BAZEL_REMOTE_CACHE=off and --config=no-remote-cache; explicitly disable any remote executor.
Use a local run environment without CI, to avoid an unintended private Buildbarn identity requirement.
Set an experiment-owned XDG_CACHE_HOME and distinct per-worktree output bases.
Prime dependency/toolchain downloads separately from measured cold-analysis cohorts.
Check exit codes, compatible target selection, actual executed tests and test results, not only command completion.
Allocate aggregate action/analysis resources and JVM heaps before concurrent runs.
limitations: Source and target definitions were inspected; no representative build/test was run in this step.
These test targets do not yet constitute a broad production binary build cohort.
